post.title: Whole-House Repiping Kirkland WA — Replacing Galvanized and Polybutylene Pipe, Plumbing Permits, Inspections and Wall Repair
post.description: A Kirkland guide to whole-house repiping: why galvanized and polybutylene supply pipe get replaced, the City of Kirkland plumbing permit, rough-in pressure testing, drywall access and patching, shutoff valves and pressure reducing valves, and how to hire a certified plumber.

notes: Box-authored fallback. Home PC DESKTOP-B69F181 board-intake inbox had no 2026-11-19 packets (per parent); PC not touched. Topic: whole-house repiping in Kirkland WA. City of Kirkland issues plumbing permits (Mechanical, Plumbing, Electrical and Fire Permit Process page: plumbing permits required for plumbing equipment or systems; applications online via MyBuildingPermit; Plumbing Permit Checklist; Single Family Plumbing Worksheet, >39 fixture units = 1 in meter); Do you need a permit page (KMC 21.06.205; like-in-kind fixture exemption only if no plumbing line modifications; drywall removal/installation needs permit; exemptions not in critical areas); permit tracking system unavailable Nov 23-24 2026; counter 123 Fifth Ave, 425-587-3600. Water: Public Works Water page (City serves South Juanita/Totem Lake southward; Northshore Utility District and Woodinville Water District serve Finn Hill, Kingsgate, North Juanita), Home-Water page (owner owns service line, shutoff, PRV; City has no record of private shutoff; meter box clearance; emergency 425-587-3900). MyBuildingPermit 2021 Plumbing Rough-In and Final checklists (water test working pressure or 50 psi 15 min, PEX air exception, PRV over 80 psi, dielectric fittings galvanized/copper, nail plates, licensed plumber on permit RCW 18.106.400). L&I Plumber Certification and trainee pages, Verify, hiring a contractor. HUD PEX design guide (PB c.1978-1995 no longer approved), InterNACHI PB page, EPA lead, Insurance Journal aging plumbing. Kirkland already in _SLUG_PLACES/_PLACE_NAMES; generate_site.py unchanged; kirkland.html unchanged.
